scope_note: Local Shadow Control Tower mock for GSE/FABLE. It simulates landing-zone guardrails, Well-Architected checks, agent refusals, SageMaker drift cards, Clean Rooms scenarios, and CDK synth fixtures without AWS credentials, deploy, or spend.

guardrails.name: Block live AWS mutation by default
guardrails.fable_gate: FABLE_AWS_ALLOW_DEPLOY=false and AWS decision engine allowed=false for mutating actions

guardrails.name: Command evidence and rollback required
guardrails.fable_gate: CODEX_FINAL_REPORT and COMMAND_LOG must record commands, outcomes, blockers, and rollback notes

guardrails.name: Zero spend until owner-approved budget exists
Model drift cards required before hosted ML
guardrails.fable_gate: local drift cards must map PSI, KL, calibration drift, and parity checks before SageMaker adoption

guardrails.name: Managed compute needs measured local bottleneck
guardrails.fable_gate: local benchmark, queue depth, or replay runtime must justify managed compute

guardrails.name: Synthetic and minimal by default
guardrails.fable_gate: fixture-only demos, bounded retention, and no always-on service before measured need

bedrock_agentcore_agents.purpose: Explain claim status and cite local evidence before public copy changes.
bedrock_agentcore_agents.self_explanation: I can summarize checked-in evidence and must say when a claim is unsupported, owner-gated, or blocked.

bedrock_agentcore_agents.purpose: Explain why an AWS action is blocked or owner-gated.
bedrock_agentcore_agents.self_explanation: I map each requested AWS action to cost, IAM, data-rights, production, and reversibility risk before any live step.

sagemaker_drift_cards.drift_signal: PSI and ECE movement across safe football segments
sagemaker_drift_cards.aws_mapping: SageMaker Model Monitor baseline and SageMaker Clarify report shape
sagemaker_drift_cards.blocked_until: local replay windows, rights-cleared features, owner-approved ML runtime, and budget approval exist

sagemaker_drift_cards.local_metric: source registry and FABLE evidence harness
sagemaker_drift_cards.aws_mapping: AWS Config detective rule and CloudWatch-style freshness metric
sagemaker_drift_cards.blocked_until: live AWS observability path is approved

clean_rooms_nfl_scenarios.allowed_output: weekly aggregate topic bins with no row-level export
clean_rooms_nfl_scenarios.disallowed_output: article-level, user-level, player-health, or bettor-level rows
clean_rooms_nfl_scenarios.minimum_aggregation_rule: n >= 25 synthetic rows per output cell

clean_rooms_nfl_scenarios.disallowed_output: raw partner data, identity joins, or external redistribution
clean_rooms_nfl_scenarios.minimum_aggregation_rule: no export below weekly aggregate grain
